name: paint-smys
description: A local-first object graphics editor with a Windows 95 look.
author: paintSMYS

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node .test-dist/tests/desktop-e2e-launch-config.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/project-save.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/project-close.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/rectangle-document.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/rectangle-geometry.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/document-history.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/plugin-api.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/plugin-runtime.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/plugin-example.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/code-card-plugin.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/text-object.test.js && node .test-dist/tests/png-export.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:desktop: electron-vite build --config electron.vite.config.ts && node examples/plugins/code-card/scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/run-desktop-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:desktop:headed: electron-vite build --config electron.vite.config.ts && node examples/plugins/code-card/scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/run-desktop-e2e.mjs --headed
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:web
